import types
if not hasattr(types, 'Union'):
    types.Union = types.UnionType  # throwaway shim: old sphinx expects py3.10-alpha name
import enum, inspect as std_inspect
from sphinx.util.inspect import object_description, stringify_signature

class MyEnum(enum.Enum):
    ValueA = 10
    ValueB = 20

# 1. object_description on enum members
assert object_description(MyEnum.ValueA) == 'MyEnum.ValueA', object_description(MyEnum.ValueA)
assert object_description(MyEnum.ValueB) == 'MyEnum.ValueB'

# 2. end-to-end signature rendering (the user-visible bug)
def ugly_enum_func(e: MyEnum = MyEnum.ValueA) -> None: ...
sig = std_inspect.signature(ugly_enum_func)
rendered = stringify_signature(sig)
print('rendered:', rendered)
assert rendered == '(e: MyEnum = MyEnum.ValueA) -> None', rendered

# 3. non-enum behaviour unchanged
assert object_description({'a': 1}) == \"{'a': 1}\"
assert object_description(3) == '3'
assert object_description('x') == \"'x'\"
assert object_description(None) == 'None'
print('ALL OK')
"
